bounds.cpu: single pure-Python process; measured wall/RSS receipts live in the unit evidence file (not embedded — the JSON is deterministic)
bounds.declared: analytic + <=22-coordinate small-matrix work only; no solver, sweep, optimizer or review family; measured run < 1 s wall, < 25 MB RSS

compatibility: the cord is UHMWPE-CLASS (Dyneema-type) with ASSUMED inherited inputs; swage compatibility is creep/slip-sensitive and NOT QUALIFIED (neither retained nor sized); potting compatibility is an ASSUMED construction on an ASSUMED 12 MPa design bond shear — not a qualified termination

dependency: corrected R3-I015 record (record imports); v3.1 follows this unit's v3 correction — v3 repairs the v2 spring model (one signed installed spring model + signed mixed-packet first loss), the bolt stack (buildable, dimensioned) and ONE cord accounting boundary, and the Pa units label

energy.drawnEtaNote: rebuilt with the drawn per-family eta on the ONE consistent law (eta = mc/(L_free_mean + 2 L_a) > 1 — v2's eta = mc/(mc + 2 L_a) treated the whole mean chord as free cord and its 1.000438088 is SUPERSEDED): the drawn chain is stiffer than the pin-jointed ideal, so the compliant-state coupled margin 1.000874096 sits just ABOVE the licensed rigid 1.0008112 — beyond-rigid is an extrapolation of the same linear model and is NOT claimed as a qualification; the quotable margin remains the licensed rigid scalar
energy.marginMatrix: M = K KD/(P_ATM SF); lambda_min(M) worst margin over all fields of unit MODAL norm ||y|| = 1, sum_n (n^2-1)(c_n^2+s_n^2) = 1
energy.pressureWork: folded into the licensed constant KD/(P_ATM SF) = 6.41500123365e-06 (SF=1); PARITY to the licensed scalar law, not an independently qualified pressure-loaded structural model
energy.pureModeCheck: the pure-mode check is numerical parity with the committed orientation_phase, NOT a physical measurement; pure-mode blocks do NOT uniquely determine the cross entries (diag(a,b) and the sqrt(ab)/2 off-diagonal matrix are both positive definite with identical pure-mode restrictions) — the cross-mode extension is an EXPLICIT ASSUMPTION carried from I015, pending independent member kinematics/energy normalisation
energy.yNormMapping: this unit's slack/norm work is on RADIAL coefficients c (cos+sin pairs); the I015 eigen machinery uses y = sqrt(D) c, D_nn = n^2-1: y_c5 = 1 maps to c5 = 1/sqrt(24) = 0.204124145232 — cross-basis comparisons carry the sqrt(D) mapping
